finding: NodeLocal served a stale cached answer immediately after the authoritative change was promoted, while CoreDNS (uncached) reflected the change instantly; NodeLocal reconverged only after its cache TTL elapsed.
measurement_note: propagation_lag_measured_s is a first-observation measurement from ~1s-interval polling of NodeLocal starting after promotion, resolution ~1 dig round-trip. propagation_lag_predicted_from_ttl_s is the independent mechanistic prediction (cache entry populated at pre_nodelocal_query, cache_ttl_s TTL, minus elapsed time to change_promoted); the two should agree within one poll interval.
